title: Title of the wizard that promotes a packaged app into the workspace. {{name}} is the app's name, {{version}} the version promoted.
title-loading: The same title while the app loads.
description: The wizard's text. {{socio}} is the socio's name (socios are the product's AI agents); its computer is the sandbox it works in. The workspace app runtime runs promoted apps.
description-loading: The same text while the app loads.
load-failed: Error when the app's promotion plan could not load.
default-name: A new dataset's suggested name. {{name}} is the app's name.
size: A file's or dataset's size ({{size}}, formatted).
steps.label: Accessible name of the list of the wizard's steps.
steps.step: One step in that list: {{number}} its number, {{name}} its name.
steps.review: Step name: review the packaged version.
steps.data: Step name: choose what happens to each dataset.
review.no-runtime: Error when this server can't run promoted apps. APPS_RUNTIME_URL is a setting's name; keep it.
review.entry: Label: the app's entry file and runtime.
review.files-value: Value: how many files ({{files}}), and their size in all ({{size}}).
review.reaches: Label: the hosts outside the workspace the app may reach.
review.reaches-nothing: Value when it reaches none. Socio is the product's name.
review.data: Label: the datasets the app uses.
review.settings: Heading of the app's settings (environment values) to fill in.
review.no-secrets: Note under those settings: don't put secrets there.
review.file-list: Summary of the collapsed list of the version's files.
data.none: Shown when the version uses no datasets.
data.kind.shared: What a dataset is: a company socio's shared dataset.
data.kind.scratch: What a dataset is: the socio's scratch (temporary) dataset.
data.kind.workspace: What a dataset is: one of the workspace's.
data.kind.missing: What a dataset is: it was deleted.
data.kind.yours: What a dataset is: the person's own.
data.tables: A dataset's tables. {{tables}} lists their technical names.
data.table-count: How many tables a dataset has.
data.shared-note: Note on a company socio's shared dataset. {{socio}} is the socio's name.
data.gone: Error on a dataset that no longer exists.
data.share-with: Accessible name of the list of Spaces to share the dataset with. Space is a product noun.
data.new-name: Accessible name of the field for the new dataset's name.
data.socio-asks: Checkbox: the socio asks to keep writing to the moved dataset, which the person approves later. {{socio}} is its name.
data.socio-reads: Checkbox: the socio keeps reading the moved dataset. {{socio}} is its name.
choices.move.title: Choice for a scratch dataset: move it into a new dataset of the person's.
choices.share.title: Choice: share the dataset with a Space (a product noun).
choices.keep.title: Choice: leave the dataset where it is.
shared-choices.move.title: Choice for a company socio's shared dataset: move it into a new workspace dataset.
shared-choices.share.title: Choice for a shared dataset: move it into a workspace dataset shared with a Space.
shared-choices.keep.title: Choice for a shared dataset: leave it where it is.
describe.none: In the final review: no choice was made for a dataset.
describe.move: In the final review: the dataset moves into a new one named {{name}}; the reads form adds that the socio keeps reading it.
describe.move-shared: In the final review: a shared dataset moves into a workspace dataset named {{name}}; the asks form adds that the socio ({{socio}}) may write to it once approved.
describe.share: In the final review: the dataset is shared with a Space ({{space}}, its name).
describe.share-shared: In the final review: a shared dataset moves into a workspace dataset ({{name}}) shared with {{space}}; the asks form adds that the socio ({{socio}}) may write to it once approved.
describe.keep: In the final review: the dataset stays where it is.
confirm.intro: The final step's text. {{version}} is the version number.
confirm.dataset: One dataset in the final review: {{name}} its name, {{choice}} what happens to it.
confirm.reaches: In the final review: the hosts the app may reach ({{hosts}}, domain names).
confirm.reaches-nothing: In the final review, when it reaches none. Socio is the product's name.
back: Button back to the previous step.
